metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz: 869 Sharpa Wave rows on the Marvin dual-arm robot (success after 669 controls, 200 rows of slack), recorded from the authoring controller tools/controller.py through tools/arm_author.py (IK to arm joint targets; motor targets only). Two fresh-process replays end with identical state hashes; float32-rounded rows also succeed. Wave-3 port of the 2026-10-14 floating-stage oracle.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7, radians), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`: the genuine right Sharpa Wave on the right flange and its declared mirror image on the left flange; 20 per hand for `wuji`: the manufacturer's left and right Wuji Hand 2.2). Both arms and both hands perform the task.
